-- 1. [상단] 일반 지원자 목록 조회 SELECT uc.campaign_id, uc.user_id, uc.user_No, u.user_nm, u.phone_Num, c.campaign_title, c.company_nm, c.company_ph, c.applicants_Num, c.recruitment_Num, c.campaign_pay as campaign_pay, -- 일반 지원자는 기본 캠페인 단가 c.work_hour, c.wage_chk, c.time_segment, uc.status, (CASE WHEN c.type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN c.type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN c.type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as type_nm, (CASE WHEN uc.status = '0' THEN '대기' WHEN uc.status = '1' THEN '출근' WHEN uc.status = '2' THEN '퇴근' WHEN uc.status = '3' THEN '지각' WHEN uc.status = '4' THEN '결근' WHEN uc.status = '5' THEN '무단' ELSE '없음' END) as status_nm, c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, c.event_Period_str, c.event_Period_End, c.result_date, uc.apply_date, c.place_addr, r.campaign_id as review_campaign_id, f.file_path, 'N' as is_leader -- 일반 지원자 구분값 FROM user_campaign uc LEFT OUTER JOIN user u ON uc.user_id = u.user_id LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c ON uc.campaign_id = c.campaign_id LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON uc.user_no = f.target_id AND f.target_type='profile' AND f.is_deleted = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN review r ON uc.campaign_id = r.campaign_id WHERE uc.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND DATE(uc.apply_date) = #{applyDate} AND uc.TIME_SEGMENT = #{timeSegment} AND uc.is_deleted = 'N'
UNION ALL -- 💥 두 결과를 결합합니다.
-- 2. [하단] 인솔자 목록 조회 (인솔자 수만큼 정확하게 나옵니다) SELECT cl.campaign_id, u.user_id, cl.user_no, u.user_nm, u.phone_Num, c.campaign_title, c.company_nm, c.company_ph, c.applicants_Num, c.recruitment_Num, cl.leader_pay as campaign_pay, -- 인솔자는 전용 급여 세팅 c.work_hour, c.wage_chk, c.time_segment, cl.status_code, (CASE WHEN c.type_code = '01' THEN '경호' WHEN c.type_code = '02' THEN '진행' WHEN c.type_code = '03' THEN '수행' ELSE '' END) as type_nm, (CASE WHEN cl.status_code = '1' THEN '출근' ELSE '대기' END) as status_nm, -- 필요에 따라 상태 코드 조건문 수정 가능 c.app_period_str, c.app_period_end, c.event_Period_str, c.event_Period_End, c.result_date, cl.apply_date, -- 💥 uc2를 지우고 인솔자는 신청일이 없으므로 깔끔하게 NULL 처리! c.place_addr, NULL as review_campaign_id, f1.file_path as file_path, 'Y' as is_leader -- 인솔자 구분값 FROM camp_leader cl INNER JOIN user u ON cl.user_no = u.id INNER JOIN campaign c ON cl.campaign_id = c.CAMPAIGN_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN files f1 ON cl.user_no = f1.target_id AND f1.target_type='profile' AND f1.is_deleted = 'N' WHERE cl.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND cl.apply_date = #{applyDate} AND cl.is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT c.campaign_id, uc.user_no AS user_no, uc.user_id AS user_id, 'USER' AS user_type, -- 일반 유저임을 구분 c.time_segment, c.wage_chk, c.work_hour, uc.apply_date, uc.status AS status, c.campaign_pay, c.uc_choice, null leader_point FROM campaign c INNER JOIN user_campaign uc ON c.campaign_id = uc.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND uc.status = '2' AND apply_date = #{applyDate} UNION ALL -- 2. 인솔자 중 status가 '9'인 대상 조회 SELECT c.campaign_id, cl.user_no AS user_no, cl.user_id AS user_id, 'LEADER' AS user_type, -- 인솔자임을 구분 c.time_segment, c.wage_chk, c.work_hour, cl.apply_date, -- cl 테이블에 맵핑할 컬럼이 없다면 NULL 처리 cl.status AS status, cl.leader_pay, c.uc_choice, cl.leader_point FROM campaign c INNER JOIN camp_leader cl ON c.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id WHERE c.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND cl.status = '9' AND apply_date = #{applyDate}
SELECT cl.campaign_id, cl.user_no, cl.user_id, cl.apply_date, cl.status FROM camp_leader cl WHERE uc.status = '9' AND uc.is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT u.id, u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.phone_num, u.role, u.guard_type, (CASE WHEN u.guard_type = '00' THEN '스텝' WHEN u.guard_type = '01' THEN '경호원 신청 중' WHEN u.guard_type = '02' THEN '경호원' WHEN u.guard_type = '03' THEN '수행' WHEN u.guard_type = '04' THEN '인솔자' ELSE '미지정' END) AS guard_type_nm, CASE WHEN sub.user_no IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS is_applied FROM user u LEFT OUTER JOIN ( -- 🔥 122번 캠페인을 신청한 유저 번호를 딱 1줄씩만 뽑아내는 가상 가방 SELECT DISTINCT user_no FROM user_campaign WHERE CAMPAIGN_ID = #{campaignId} AND is_deleted = 'N' UNION -- 💡 두 테이블의 유저 번호를 합치고 중복은 자동 제거 -- 2. 인솔자 배정 명단 SELECT DISTINCT user_no FROM camp_leader WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ) sub ON u.id = sub.user_no WHERE
( u.guard_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{option.code}, '%') AND u.user_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{option.keyword}, '%')
) AND
u.is_deleted = 'N' AND u.role != 'Admin' ORDER BY u.user_nm, u.id

mapper.update: UPDATE campaign c JOIN ( -- 💡 여기서 미리 캠페인별 인원수를 정확하게 계산해 둡니다. SELECT uc.campaign_id, COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_id) + count(DISTINCT cl.user_no) as cnt FROM user_campaign uc LEFT OUTER JOIN camp_leader cl ON uc.campaign_id = cl.campaign_id WHERE uc.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND uc.is_deleted = 'N' AND (uc.lead_apply = 'Y' OR uc.lead_apply IS NULL) GROUP BY uc.campaign_id ) t ON c.campaign_id = t.campaign_id SET c.applicants_num = t.cnt WHERE c.campaign_id = #{campaignId};
